in_sanskrit.name: Ramkishun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Ram, Lord of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ramkishun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ramkishun is derived from the name Ram, which is the name of the seventh avatar of Lord Vishnu, and kishun meaning lord of strength. This name is given to a baby boy to bless him with the strength, power, and victory in life.
